description: Baofeng UV-5R channels + radio-wide settings (radio EEPROM addresses; Chirp image offset = radio + 8)

warning.title: Service calibration values
warning.description: Change only with appropriate test equipment.

ui.label: S-CODE
ui.description: Which stored PTT-ID code this memory channel sends. The codes themselves are edited under DTMF.

ui.label: Power
ui.description: Transmit power for this memory channel. High is full power. Low reduces power and battery use.

ui.label: Mode
ui.description: FM bandwidth for this memory channel. Wide is the broader channel. Narrow is the tighter 12.5 kHz channel.

ui.label: BCL
ui.description: Busy channel lockout for this memory channel. When on, the radio will not transmit if it is already receiving a signal.

ui.label: Scan
ui.description: Includes this memory channel when you start a scan. Menu 18 (SC-REV) chooses whether scan resumes on a timer, when the carrier drops, or stops on the first signal.

ui.label: PTT-ID
ui.description: When this memory channel sends its PTT-ID. Off sends nothing. BOT sends it when you press PTT, EOT when you release, and Both at both times.

ui.label: PTT ID Code
ui.description: DTMF digits sent as the PTT-ID for this code slot. A channel or VFO S-CODE setting chooses which slot is sent.

ui.label: Alarm Code
ui.description: DTMF code transmitted when alarm mode is set to Code (menu 32, AL-MOD).

ui.label: ANI Code
ui.description: Automatic Number Identification sent with PTT-ID. The radio shows this code on menu 15. Digits only.

ui.label: ANI ID
ui.description: When the ANI code is sent. Off sends nothing. BOT sends it when you press PTT, EOT when you release, and Both at both times.

ui.label: DTMF Speed (on)
ui.description: How long each DTMF tone is transmitted.

ui.label: DTMF Speed (off)
ui.description: Silent gap between transmitted DTMF tones.

ui.label: Carrier Squelch Level
ui.description: How strong a received signal must be before the speaker opens. 0 leaves the squelch open, so you hear all noise. Higher numbers mute weaker signals.

ui.label: Frequency Step (kHz)
ui.description: Tuning step, in kHz, used when you turn the knob or press up and down in frequency mode.

ui.label: Battery Saver
ui.description: How long the receiver listens versus how long it sleeps. Off keeps it awake. 1:1 listens as long as it sleeps. 1:4 sleeps four times longer than it listens, which saves the most battery and can miss the start of a short call.

ui.label: VOX Sensitivity
ui.description: Transmits when the radio hears your voice, without the PTT key. Off disables it. 1 is the most sensitive; 10 needs a louder voice.

ui.label: Backlight Timeout
ui.description: How long the display backlight stays on after a keypress, in seconds. 0 turns the backlight off. Some UV-5R firmware only offers a shorter list from the keypad.

ui.label: Dual Watch
ui.description: Dual watch. The radio checks both the A and B frequencies and opens the speaker for whichever one is busy.

ui.label: Beep
ui.description: Beeps when you press a key. Turn this off for a silent keypad.

ui.label: Timeout Timer
ui.description: Stops a transmission that runs longer than this, so a stuck PTT cannot hold the channel. The radio then returns to receive.

ui.label: Voice
ui.description: Spoken prompts for keys and menus. Off is silent. English or Chinese speaks the selection.

ui.label: DTMF Sidetone
ui.description: Which DTMF tones you hear in the speaker while transmitting. Off is silent. DT-ST plays keypad tones, ANI-ST plays the ANI or PTT-ID, and DT+ANI plays both.

ui.label: Scan Resume
ui.description: What scan does after it stops on a signal. TO resumes after a few seconds. CO resumes when the carrier drops. SE stops and stays on the first signal.

ui.label: PTT ID
ui.description: When the selected PTT-ID code is sent. Off sends nothing. BOT sends it when you press PTT, EOT when you release PTT, and Both at both times.

ui.label: PTT ID Delay
ui.description: How long the radio waits after you press PTT before it sends the ANI or PTT-ID code.

ui.label: Display Mode (A)
ui.description: What display line A shows for a memory channel: the channel number, the stored name, or the frequency.

ui.label: Display Mode (B)
ui.description: What display line B shows for a memory channel: the channel number, the stored name, or the frequency.

ui.label: Busy Channel Lockout
ui.description: Busy channel lockout. When on, the radio will not transmit if it is already receiving a signal.

ui.label: Automatic Key Lock
ui.description: Locks the keypad after a few seconds with no keypress. The PTT key still works. Hold # to unlock.

ui.label: Shift Direction
ui.description: Repeater shift for the VFO. Off transmits on the receive frequency. + transmits above it by the offset, and − transmits below it.

ui.label: Standby LED Color
ui.description: LED color while the radio is idle, not receiving or transmitting.

ui.label: RX LED Color
ui.description: LED color while the radio is receiving a signal.

ui.label: TX LED Color
ui.description: LED color while the radio is transmitting.

ui.label: Alarm Mode
ui.description: What the alarm does. Site sounds only in your speaker. Tone transmits an alarm tone. Code transmits the programmed alarm DTMF code.

ui.label: Band
ui.description: Band for the VFO. The keypad menu offers VHF or UHF.

ui.label: Dual Watch TX Priority
ui.description: Which display transmits while dual watch is on. Off uses the display you selected. A or B forces transmit on that line.

ui.label: Squelch Tail Eliminate (HT to HT)
ui.description: Squelch tail elimination between two handhelds. Removes the noise burst you hear when the other station releases PTT on a tone-coded channel.

ui.label: Squelch Tail Eliminate (repeater)
ui.description: Squelch tail elimination for a repeater. Off leaves the noise burst when the repeater drops. Higher numbers hold your squelch closed longer.

ui.label: STE Repeater Delay
ui.description: Delay before repeater squelch-tail elimination. Off disables the delay.

ui.label: Power-On Message
ui.description: What you see at power-on. Full shows the normal startup screen. Message shows the two programmed lines.

ui.label: Roger Beep
ui.description: Sends a short courtesy tone when you release PTT, so the other station can tell you are done.

ui.label: Roger Beep (RX)
ui.description: Which display line indicates a received roger beep. This is not a numbered item on the stock UV-5R keypad menu.

ui.label: Display
ui.description: Which display line the knob and keypad tune. A is the top line and B is the bottom line. The A/B key switches this.

ui.label: Broadcast FM Radio
ui.description: Turns the broadcast FM receiver on. On the radio this is the CALL key, not a numbered menu. A ham signal interrupts the broadcast.

ui.label: Alarm Sound
ui.description: Allows the alarm tone. Menu 32 (AL-MOD) chooses whether that alarm stays local or is transmitted.

ui.label: RESET Menu
ui.description: Shows or hides keypad menu 40. Turn this off to keep a VFO or full reset from being started on the radio.

ui.label: All Menus
ui.description: When off, the keypad menu is locked so numbered settings cannot be changed from the radio.

ui.label: VFO/MR Mode
ui.description: Mode restored at power-on. Frequency is VFO tuning. Channel is memory mode. The VFO/MR key switches this on the radio.

ui.label: Keypad Lock
ui.description: Current keypad lock. Hold # on the radio to lock or unlock. Menu 24 (AUTOLK) can lock it automatically.

ui.label: MR A Channel
ui.description: Memory channel selected on display A in channel mode.

ui.label: MR B Channel
ui.description: Memory channel selected on display B in channel mode.

ui.label: VFO A Frequency
ui.description: Receive frequency on display line A while the radio is in frequency mode, in Hz.

ui.label: VFO A Offset
ui.description: How far the transmit frequency sits from the receive frequency when shift is + or −, in Hz.

ui.label: VFO A Shift
ui.description: Repeater shift for VFO A. Off transmits on the receive frequency. + transmits above it, and − transmits below it.

ui.label: VFO A S-CODE
ui.description: Which stored PTT-ID code VFO A sends. The codes themselves are edited under DTMF.

ui.label: VFO A Tuning Step
ui.description: Tuning step for VFO A, in kHz.

ui.label: VFO A Power
ui.description: Transmit power for VFO A. High is full power. Low reduces power and battery use.

ui.label: VFO A Bandwidth
ui.description: FM bandwidth for VFO A. Wide is the broader channel. Narrow is the tighter 12.5 kHz channel.

ui.label: VFO B Frequency
ui.description: Receive frequency on display line B while the radio is in frequency mode, in Hz.

ui.label: VFO B Offset
ui.description: How far the transmit frequency sits from the receive frequency when shift is + or −, in Hz.

ui.label: VFO B Shift
ui.description: Repeater shift for VFO B. Off transmits on the receive frequency. + transmits above it, and − transmits below it.

ui.label: VFO B S-CODE
ui.description: Which stored PTT-ID code VFO B sends. The codes themselves are edited under DTMF.

ui.label: VFO B Tuning Step
ui.description: Tuning step for VFO B, in kHz.

ui.label: VFO B Power
ui.description: Transmit power for VFO B. High is full power. Low reduces power and battery use.

ui.label: VFO B Bandwidth
ui.description: FM bandwidth for VFO B. Wide is the broader channel. Narrow is the tighter 12.5 kHz channel.

ui.label: 6+Power-On Message 1
ui.description: First power-on line used by some UV-5R firmware. Shown when menu 38 (PONMSG) is set to Message.

ui.label: 6+Power-On Message 2
ui.description: Second power-on line used by some UV-5R firmware. Shown when menu 38 (PONMSG) is set to Message.

ui.label: Power-On Message 1
ui.description: First line shown at power-on when menu 38 (PONMSG) is set to Message.

ui.label: Power-On Message 2
ui.description: Second line shown at power-on when menu 38 (PONMSG) is set to Message.

ui.label: Firmware Message 1
ui.description: Firmware banner stored in the radio. The radio displays this; it cannot be edited here.

ui.label: Firmware Message 2
ui.description: Second line of the firmware banner stored in the radio.
